earnings.title: Earnings calendar
earnings.empty_body: The calendar reads the stocks on your watchlist; crypto and funds never report earnings. Add a ticker and its next reporting date, the consensus for the quarter and its past results all show up here.
earnings.no_dates: No earnings dates found for the watchlist.
earnings.skipped_note: Not on the calendar: {names} — crypto and funds never report earnings.
earnings.no_figures: No reported figures for this date.
earnings.price_reaction_caption: Price reaction spans the print: last close before the date vs first close after, so it always contains the gap regardless of pre/post market timing.
earnings.no_match_filters: No earnings dates match the selected filters.
earnings.calendar_legend: Red chips = report within 7 days. Green ▲ / red ▼ = past beat/miss — click for the result overview. Blue cell = today.
earnings.quarter_pending: The income statement for this quarter isn't published yet — revenue, margins and the GAAP result appear once the filing lands.
earnings.no_quarter_data: No quarterly income statement available for this ticker.
earnings.sub_revenue: What the quarter billed, and where the trend sits
earnings.tip_ttm: Sum of the last four reported quarters.
earnings.sub_margins: Share of revenue, change vs the same quarter last year
earnings.margins_caption: Margins are computed from the filed income statement (line / revenue), so a one-off gain or charge lands in them unsmoothed.
earnings.sub_gaap: As filed on the quarterly income statement
earnings.tip_tax_rate: Tax provision / pretax income for the quarter.
earnings.tip_shares: Diluted weighted-average count. More shares dilute per-share value; fewer (buybacks) lift it.
earnings.sub_eps: Headline vs GAAP diluted, and the surprise track record
earnings.tip_headline_eps: As published by the earnings feed — for most companies an adjusted (non-GAAP) figure, which is what the estimate is set against.
earnings.tip_gaap_eps: Diluted EPS as filed on the income statement. The gap to the headline figure is the adjustment.
earnings.outlook_caption: Company guidance is not in any free data feed. These are sell-side consensus figures: the bar with the mean marked on it spans the analyst low-high range, so a wide band means the street disagrees.
earnings.tax_legend: Amber chips = tax deadlines for {country}. Statutory dates: public holidays and yearly changes are not modelled, so check the tax authority's calendar. You are reminded 30 days ahead.
earnings.tax_es_modelo_720_body: Informative return on securities and accounts held abroad, only if they exceeded 50,000 € on 31 December {year} (or grew by more than 20,000 € since the last one).
earnings.tax_es_modelo_721_body: Informative return on crypto held with foreign custodians, only if it exceeded 50,000 € on 31 December {year}.
earnings.tax_es_renta_body: Last day of the IRPF campaign for {year} (it opens in early April). Gains, losses and dividends go in the savings base; a direct-debit payment closes a few days earlier.
earnings.tax_es_renta_second_body: If you split the {year} IRPF payment, the remaining 40% is charged today.
earnings.tax_us_form_1040_body: Federal return and balance due for {year}, Schedule D and Form 8949 included. Form 4868 extends the filing, not the payment.
earnings.tax_us_fbar_body: FinCEN 114 if your foreign accounts together exceeded $10,000 at any point in {year}. Automatically extended to 15 October.
earnings.tax_us_extension_body: Last day to file the {year} return if you requested an extension (Form 4868). The FBAR's automatic extension ends too.
earnings.tax_us_estimated_q1_body: First 1040-ES payment for {year}, if realized gains or dividends leave you owing $1,000 or more.
earnings.tax_uk_self_assessment_body: Online return and balancing payment for {year}, with the capital gains pages; the first payment on account for the next year is due too.
earnings.tax_uk_payment_on_account_body: Second payment on account towards the {year} Self Assessment bill.
earnings.tax_de_steuererklaerung_body: Return for {year} if you file it yourself — needed for Anlage KAP when a foreign broker withheld no Abgeltungsteuer. With a tax adviser the deadline is later.
earnings.tax_fr_declaration_body: Online return for {year} with forms 2074 and 3916 for foreign accounts. The exact day depends on your département (late May to early June).
earnings.tax_it_saldo_body: Balance for {year} (capital gains tax and IVAFE included) and first advance for the next year; 30 July with a 0.4% surcharge.
earnings.tax_it_modello_730_body: Last day to file the 730 for {year}.
earnings.tax_it_redditi_body: Online return for {year}, where quadro RW (foreign assets) and RT (capital gains) go.
earnings.tax_ie_cgt_initial_body: Capital gains tax on disposals from 1 January to 30 November {year}.
earnings.tax_ie_cgt_later_body: Capital gains tax on disposals made in December {year}.
earnings.tax_ie_form_11_body: Return for {year}, declaring the year's chargeable gains. Filing through ROS usually gets a few extra weeks.
earnings.tax_pt_irs_body: Last day of the IRS campaign for {year} (it opens 1 April), with annex G for gains and J for foreign income.
earnings.tax_ca_t1_body: Return and balance owing for {year}, with Schedule 3 and T1135 if foreign property cost more than $100,000.
earnings.tax_au_tax_return_body: Self-lodged return for {year} with its capital gains. Through a registered tax agent it is usually later.
earnings.tax_ch_declaration_body: Return for {year} with the securities list for wealth tax. The deadline is set by your canton (most: 31 March) and extensions are routine.
